# Generated by tools/build_mod.py. Country scope except state-targeted actions.
# Explicit opt-in on both new campaigns and existing saves. Approved actions only.
sed_enable_country = {
 if = {
  limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_schema_version } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_schema_version value = 1 }
 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_enabled value = yes }
 set_variable = { name = sed_monthly_refresh value = yes }
 set_variable = { name = sed_railway_action_status value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_construction_action_status value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_wood_action_status value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_iron_action_status value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_coal_action_status value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_grain_action_status value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_action_status value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_tools_action_status value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_groceries_action_status value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_clothes_action_status value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_small_arms_action_status value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_artillery_action_status value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_ammunition_action_status value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_paper_action_status value = 0 }
 if = {
  limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_variable = sed_mode_manual has_variable = sed_mode_assisted has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } } }
  sed_set_mode_assisted = yes
 }
 sed_refresh_diagnostics = yes
 sed_ensure_journal_entry = yes
}

sed_ensure_journal_entry = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   has_variable = sed_enabled
   NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_sed_diagnostics }
   NOT = { has_inactive_journal_entry = je_sed_diagnostics }
  }
  add_journal_entry = { type = je_sed_diagnostics }
 }
}

sed_monthly_update = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled }
  sed_ensure_journal_entry = yes
  if = {
   limit = { has_variable = sed_monthly_refresh }
   sed_refresh_diagnostics = yes
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_active } sed_refresh_national_plan = yes sed_coord_sync = yes }
  sed_schedule_auto_event = yes
 }
}

sed_refresh_diagnostics = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled }
  sed_ensure_mode_default = yes
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_economy_health_effects.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_balance value = net_total_income }
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_core_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_operating_balance value = net_fixed_income }
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_core_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_fixed_expenses value = fixed_expenses }
 # vanilla/common/script_values/war_support_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_gold value = gold_reserves }
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_economy_health_effects.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_debt value = principal }
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_economy_health_effects.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_credit value = credit }
 # vanilla/common/script_values/ip5_je_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_gdp value = gdp }
 # vanilla/common/script_values/ip5_je_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_population value = total_population }
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_economy_health_effects.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_sol value = average_sol }
 # vanilla/common/journal_entries/00_sick_man.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_literacy value = literacy_rate }
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_core_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_construction value = modifier:country_construction_add }
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_core_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_public_projects value = num_queued_government_constructions }
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_core_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_private_projects value = num_queued_private_constructions }
 # vanilla/common/script_values/01_power_bloc_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_military_expenses value = military_expenses }
 # vanilla/common/script_values/01_power_bloc_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_military_share value = military_expenses_share }
  set_variable = { name = sed_last_year value = year }
  # The game's month trigger is zero-based (vanilla ip4_custom_loc.txt).
  set_variable = { name = sed_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_month_key value = { value = year multiply = 12 add = month } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_in_default value = 0 }
  if = { limit = { in_default = yes } set_variable = { name = sed_in_default value = 1 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_gdp_per_capita value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_per_capita_available value = 0 }
  if = {
   limit = { var:sed_population > 0 }
   set_variable = { name = sed_gdp_per_capita value = { value = var:sed_gdp divide = var:sed_population } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_per_capita_available value = 1 }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_debt_share value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_debt_share_available value = 0 }
  if = {
   limit = { var:sed_credit > 0 }
   set_variable = { name = sed_debt_share value = { value = var:sed_debt divide = var:sed_credit } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_debt_share_available value = 1 }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_reserve_weeks value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_reserve_weeks_available value = 0 }
  if = {
   limit = { var:sed_balance < 0 }
   set_variable = { name = sed_reserve_weeks value = { value = var:sed_gold min = 0 divide = { value = var:sed_balance multiply = -1 } } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_reserve_weeks_available value = 1 }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_states value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_infrastructure_short_states value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_low_access_states value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_shortage_buildings value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_understaffed_buildings value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_hiring_failure_buildings value = 0 }
  every_scope_state = {
   root = { change_variable = { name = sed_states add = 1 } }
   if = { limit = { infrastructure_delta < 0 } root = { change_variable = { name = sed_infrastructure_short_states add = 1 } } }
   if = { limit = { market_access < 1 } root = { change_variable = { name = sed_low_access_states add = 1 } } }
   every_scope_building = {
    limit = { level > 0 }
    if = { limit = { building_has_goods_shortage = yes } root = { change_variable = { name = sed_shortage_buildings add = 1 } } }
    if = { limit = { occupancy < 1 } root = { change_variable = { name = sed_understaffed_buildings add = 1 } } }
    if = { limit = { has_failed_hires = yes } root = { change_variable = { name = sed_hiring_failure_buildings add = 1 } } }
   }
  }
  sed_update_growth = yes
  sed_refresh_railway_candidates = yes
  sed_refresh_construction_candidates = yes
  sed_refresh_supply_candidates = yes
  sed_refresh_national_plan = yes
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_active } sed_coord_sync = yes }
 }
}

sed_refresh_railway_candidates = {
 clear_variable_list = sed_railway_candidates
 # Counts use one primary reason per state so the breakdown adds up to the
 # deficit total instead of counting the same state under several filters.
 set_variable = { name = sed_railway_ignored_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_railway_deficit_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_railway_no_railway_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_railway_not_ready_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_railway_blocked_states value = 0 }
 every_scope_state = {
  if = {
   limit = {
    has_variable = sed_railway_request_pending
    NOT = {
     OR = {
      AND = { has_building = building_railway
       b:building_railway = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } }
      # A founded railway has no building yet; the queue itself proves it is
      # still in progress. Without this, the request was cleared as abandoned
      # on the next reading and could be founded again elsewhere.
      AND = { NOT = { has_building = building_railway }
       var:sed_railway_intent_level = 0
       owner = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > 0 } }
     }
    }
   }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_railway_intent_level
     has_building = building_railway
     b:building_railway.level > var:sed_railway_intent_level
    }
    sed_railway_record_completed = yes
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_railway_intent_level }
    sed_railway_record_abandoned = yes
   }
   remove_variable = sed_railway_request_pending
   remove_variable = sed_railway_intent_level
  }
  if = {
   limit = { infrastructure_delta < 0 }
   root = { change_variable = { name = sed_railway_deficit_states add = 1 } }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_railway_ignored }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_railway_ignored_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_railway } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_railway_no_railway_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = {
     b:building_railway = {
      OR = {
       level <= 0
       occupancy < 0.8
       has_failed_hires = yes
       building_has_goods_shortage = yes
       level_after_queued_constructions > level
      }
     }
    }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_railway_not_ready_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = {
     OR = {
      NOT = { is_incorporated = yes }
      NOT = { can_construct_building = building_railway }
     }
    }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_railway_blocked_states add = 1 } }
   }
  }
 }
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled }
  ordered_scope_state = {
   limit = { sed_railway_candidate_eligible = yes }
   order_by = { value = infrastructure_delta multiply = -1 }
   max = 3
   check_range_bounds = no
   root = {
    add_to_variable_list = { name = sed_railway_candidates target = prev }
   }
  }
 }
}

sed_run_railway_approval = {
 owner = { if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } sed_refresh_direct_budget = yes } }
 if = {
  limit = { sed_railway_approval_valid = yes }
  owner = {
   set_variable = { name = sed_queue_levels_before value = construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels }
  }
  owner = { sed_record_auto_attempt = yes }
  # A founding reads level 0; a later reading infers completion from the queue.
  if = { limit = { has_building = building_railway }
   set_variable = { name = sed_railway_intent_level value = b:building_railway.level }
  }
  else = { set_variable = { name = sed_railway_intent_level value = 0 } }
  start_building_construction = building_railway
  owner = {
   if = {
    limit = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > var:sed_queue_levels_before }
    set_variable = { name = sed_railway_action_status value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_railway_intents }
     change_variable = { name = sed_railway_intents add = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = sed_railway_intents value = 1 } }
    prev = { set_variable = { name = sed_railway_request_pending value = yes } }
   }
   else = {
    set_variable = { name = sed_railway_action_status value = 2 }
    prev = { remove_variable = sed_railway_intent_level }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_queue_levels_before
  }
 }
}

sed_refresh_construction_candidates = {
 clear_variable_list = sed_construction_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_wood_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_iron_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_coal_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_grain_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_fabric_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_tools_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_groceries_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_clothes_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_small_arms_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_artillery_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_ammunition_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_paper_candidates
 # Same primary-reason cascade as the railway counts. Only states that already
 # have a construction sector enter this denominator.
 set_variable = { name = sed_construction_ignored_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_construction_infrastructure_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_construction_sector_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_construction_not_ready_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_construction_blocked_states value = 0 }
 every_scope_state = {
  if = {
   limit = {
    has_variable = sed_construction_request_pending
    OR = {
     NOT = { has_building = building_construction_sector }
     b:building_construction_sector = { level_after_queued_constructions <= level }
    }
   }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_construction_intent_level
     has_building = building_construction_sector
     b:building_construction_sector.level > var:sed_construction_intent_level
    }
    sed_construction_record_completed = yes
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_construction_intent_level }
    sed_construction_record_abandoned = yes
   }
   remove_variable = sed_construction_request_pending
   remove_variable = sed_construction_intent_level
  }
  if = {
   limit = { has_building = building_construction_sector }
   root = { change_variable = { name = sed_construction_sector_states add = 1 } }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_construction_ignored }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_construction_ignored_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = {
     b:building_construction_sector = {
      OR = {
       level <= 0
       occupancy < 0.9
       has_failed_hires = yes
       building_has_goods_shortage = yes
       level_after_queued_constructions > level
      }
     }
    }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_construction_not_ready_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = {
     OR = {
      NOT = { is_incorporated = yes }
      NOT = { can_construct_building = building_construction_sector }
     }
    }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_construction_blocked_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { infrastructure_delta < 0 }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_construction_infrastructure_states add = 1 } }
   }
  }
 }
 if = {
  limit = {
   is_player = yes
   has_variable = sed_enabled
   num_queued_government_constructions >= 3
  }
  ordered_scope_state = {
   limit = { sed_construction_candidate_eligible = yes }
   order_by = { value = state_population }
   max = 1
   check_range_bounds = no
   root = {
    add_to_variable_list = { name = sed_construction_candidates target = prev }
   }
  }
 }
}

sed_run_construction_approval = {
 owner = { if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } sed_refresh_direct_budget = yes } }
 if = {
  limit = { sed_construction_approval_valid = yes }
  owner = {
   set_variable = { name = sed_queue_levels_before value = construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels }
  }
  owner = { sed_record_auto_attempt = yes }
  set_variable = { name = sed_construction_intent_level value = b:building_construction_sector.level }
  start_building_construction = building_construction_sector
  owner = {
   if = {
    limit = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > var:sed_queue_levels_before }
    set_variable = { name = sed_construction_action_status value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_construction_intents }
     change_variable = { name = sed_construction_intents add = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = sed_construction_intents value = 1 } }
    prev = { set_variable = { name = sed_construction_request_pending value = yes } }
   }
   else = {
    set_variable = { name = sed_construction_action_status value = 2 }
    prev = { remove_variable = sed_construction_intent_level }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_queue_levels_before
  }
 }
}

# Country counters; completion is inferred from the queue leaving and level rising.
sed_railway_record_completed = {
 owner = {
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_railway_completed }
   change_variable = { name = sed_railway_completed add = 1 }
  }
  else = { set_variable = { name = sed_railway_completed value = 1 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_railway_result value = 1 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_railway_result_month value = sed_live_month_key }
 }
 remove_variable = sed_railway_intent_level
}

sed_railway_record_abandoned = {
 owner = {
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_railway_abandoned }
   change_variable = { name = sed_railway_abandoned add = 1 }
  }
  else = { set_variable = { name = sed_railway_abandoned value = 1 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_railway_result value = 2 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_railway_result_month value = sed_live_month_key }
 }
 remove_variable = sed_railway_intent_level
}

sed_construction_record_completed = {
 owner = {
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_construction_completed }
   change_variable = { name = sed_construction_completed add = 1 }
  }
  else = { set_variable = { name = sed_construction_completed value = 1 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_construction_result value = 1 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_construction_result_month value = sed_live_month_key }
 }
 remove_variable = sed_construction_intent_level
}

sed_construction_record_abandoned = {
 owner = {
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_construction_abandoned }
   change_variable = { name = sed_construction_abandoned add = 1 }
  }
  else = { set_variable = { name = sed_construction_abandoned value = 1 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_construction_result value = 2 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_construction_result_month value = sed_live_month_key }
 }
 remove_variable = sed_construction_intent_level
}

# Keep the first sample of each recorded month as the anchor. A second click in
# the same month cannot erase the baseline or pretend that a whole month passed.
sed_update_growth = {
 if = {
  limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_anchor_month } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_anchor_month value = var:sed_month_key }
  set_variable = { name = sed_anchor_gdp value = var:sed_gdp }
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { var:sed_month_key > var:sed_anchor_month }
  set_variable = { name = sed_previous_month value = var:sed_anchor_month }
  set_variable = { name = sed_previous_gdp value = var:sed_anchor_gdp }
  set_variable = { name = sed_anchor_month value = var:sed_month_key }
  set_variable = { name = sed_anchor_gdp value = var:sed_gdp }
 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_growth_available value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_growth value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_growth_months value = 0 }
 if = {
  limit = { has_variable = sed_previous_gdp var:sed_previous_gdp > 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_growth value = { value = var:sed_gdp divide = var:sed_previous_gdp subtract = 1 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_growth_months value = { value = var:sed_month_key subtract = var:sed_previous_month } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_growth_available value = 1 }
 }
}
sed_ensure_mode_default = {
 if = {
  limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_variable = sed_mode_manual has_variable = sed_mode_assisted has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } } }
  sed_set_mode_assisted = yes
 }
}

# Country scope; the persistent marker is written before an automatic attempt.
sed_record_auto_attempt = {
 if = {
  limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic }
  set_variable = { name = sed_auto_last_attempt_month value = { value = year multiply = 12 add = month } }
 }
}

sed_refresh_supply_candidates = {
 sed_refresh_input_readings = yes
 set_variable = { name = sed_wood_producer_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_wood_ignored_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_wood_pending_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_wood_unincorporated_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_wood_understaffed_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_wood_hiring_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_wood_input_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_wood_method_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_wood_permission_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_wood_infrastructure_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_wood_labor_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_wood_forecast_states value = 0 }
 clear_variable_list = sed_wood_candidates
 every_scope_state = {
  if = {
   limit = { has_variable = sed_wood_request_pending
    NOT = { OR = { AND = { has_variable = sed_wood_intent_variant OR = { AND = { var:sed_wood_intent_variant = 1 has_building = building_logging_camp b:building_logging_camp = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } } } AND = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_wood_intent_variant } OR = { AND = { has_building = building_logging_camp b:building_logging_camp = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } } } AND = { var:sed_wood_intent_level = 0 NOT = { has_building = building_logging_camp } owner = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > 0 } } } }
   }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_wood_intent_variant has_variable = sed_wood_intent_level }
    if = {
     limit = { var:sed_wood_intent_variant = 1
      has_building = building_logging_camp
      b:building_logging_camp.level > var:sed_wood_intent_level
     }
     sed_wood_record_completed = yes
    }
    else = { sed_wood_record_abandoned = yes }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_wood_request_pending
  }
  if = {
   limit = { OR = { has_building = building_logging_camp } }
   root = { change_variable = { name = sed_wood_producer_states add = 1 } }
  }
  if = { limit = { sed_wood_candidate_eligible = yes } }
  else_if = {
   limit = { has_building = building_logging_camp }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_wood_ignored }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_wood_ignored_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { OR = { has_variable = sed_wood_request_pending b:building_logging_camp = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_wood_pending_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { is_incorporated = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_wood_unincorporated_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_logging_camp = { OR = { level <= 0 occupancy < 0.8 } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_wood_understaffed_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_logging_camp = { has_failed_hires = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_wood_hiring_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { sed_state_labor_available < 5000 }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_wood_labor_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_logging_camp = { building_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_wood_input_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { sed_input_logging_camp_safe = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_wood_forecast_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { OR = { b:building_logging_camp = { NOT = { OR = { has_active_production_method = pm_electric_saw_mills has_active_production_method = pm_saw_mills has_active_production_method = pm_simple_forestry } } } sed_investment_logging_camp_output <= 0 } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_wood_method_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { can_construct_building = building_logging_camp } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_wood_permission_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { infrastructure_delta < 0 }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_wood_infrastructure_states add = 1 } }
   }
  }
 }
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled
   sed_wood_supply_demand = yes
  }
  ordered_scope_state = {
   limit = { sed_wood_candidate_eligible = yes }
   order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
   max = 3
   check_range_bounds = no
   root = { add_to_variable_list = { name = sed_wood_candidates target = prev } }
  }
 }

 set_variable = { name = sed_grain_producer_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_grain_ignored_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_grain_pending_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_grain_unincorporated_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_grain_understaffed_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_grain_hiring_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_grain_input_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_grain_method_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_grain_permission_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_grain_infrastructure_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_grain_labor_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_grain_forecast_states value = 0 }
 clear_variable_list = sed_grain_candidates
 every_scope_state = {
  if = {
   limit = { has_variable = sed_grain_request_pending
    NOT = { OR = { AND = { has_variable = sed_grain_intent_variant OR = { AND = { var:sed_grain_intent_variant = 1 has_building = building_wheat_farm b:building_wheat_farm = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } AND = { var:sed_grain_intent_variant = 2 has_building = building_rye_farm b:building_rye_farm = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } AND = { var:sed_grain_intent_variant = 3 has_building = building_rice_farm b:building_rice_farm = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } AND = { var:sed_grain_intent_variant = 4 has_building = building_maize_farm b:building_maize_farm = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } AND = { var:sed_grain_intent_variant = 5 has_building = building_millet_farm b:building_millet_farm = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } } } AND = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_grain_intent_variant } OR = { AND = { has_building = building_wheat_farm b:building_wheat_farm = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } AND = { has_building = building_rye_farm b:building_rye_farm = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } AND = { has_building = building_rice_farm b:building_rice_farm = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } AND = { has_building = building_maize_farm b:building_maize_farm = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } AND = { has_building = building_millet_farm b:building_millet_farm = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } } } AND = { var:sed_grain_intent_level = 0 NOT = { has_building = building_wheat_farm has_building = building_rye_farm has_building = building_rice_farm has_building = building_maize_farm has_building = building_millet_farm } owner = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > 0 } } } }
   }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_grain_intent_variant has_variable = sed_grain_intent_level }
    if = {
     limit = { var:sed_grain_intent_variant = 1
      has_building = building_wheat_farm
      b:building_wheat_farm.level > var:sed_grain_intent_level
     }
     sed_grain_record_completed = yes
    }
    else_if = {
     limit = { var:sed_grain_intent_variant = 2
      has_building = building_rye_farm
      b:building_rye_farm.level > var:sed_grain_intent_level
     }
     sed_grain_record_completed = yes
    }
    else_if = {
     limit = { var:sed_grain_intent_variant = 3
      has_building = building_rice_farm
      b:building_rice_farm.level > var:sed_grain_intent_level
     }
     sed_grain_record_completed = yes
    }
    else_if = {
     limit = { var:sed_grain_intent_variant = 4
      has_building = building_maize_farm
      b:building_maize_farm.level > var:sed_grain_intent_level
     }
     sed_grain_record_completed = yes
    }
    else_if = {
     limit = { var:sed_grain_intent_variant = 5
      has_building = building_millet_farm
      b:building_millet_farm.level > var:sed_grain_intent_level
     }
     sed_grain_record_completed = yes
    }
    else = { sed_grain_record_abandoned = yes }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_grain_request_pending
  }
  if = {
   limit = { OR = { has_building = building_wheat_farm has_building = building_rye_farm has_building = building_rice_farm has_building = building_maize_farm has_building = building_millet_farm } }
   root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_producer_states add = 1 } }
  }
  if = { limit = { sed_grain_candidate_eligible = yes } }
  else_if = {
   limit = { has_building = building_wheat_farm }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_grain_ignored }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_ignored_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { OR = { has_variable = sed_grain_request_pending b:building_wheat_farm = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_pending_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { is_incorporated = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_unincorporated_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_wheat_farm = { OR = { level <= 0 occupancy < 0.8 } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_understaffed_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_wheat_farm = { has_failed_hires = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_hiring_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { sed_state_labor_available < 5000 }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_labor_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_wheat_farm = { building_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_input_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { sed_input_wheat_farm_safe = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_forecast_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { OR = { b:building_wheat_farm = { NOT = { OR = { has_active_production_method = pm_chemical_fertilizer has_active_production_method = pm_fertilization has_active_production_method = pm_herring_meal_farming has_active_production_method = pm_simple_farming has_active_production_method = pm_soil_enriching_farming } } } sed_investment_wheat_farm_output <= 0 } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_method_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { can_construct_building = building_wheat_farm } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_permission_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { infrastructure_delta < 0 }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_infrastructure_states add = 1 } }
   }
  }  else_if = {
   limit = { has_building = building_rye_farm }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_grain_ignored }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_ignored_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { OR = { has_variable = sed_grain_request_pending b:building_rye_farm = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_pending_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { is_incorporated = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_unincorporated_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_rye_farm = { OR = { level <= 0 occupancy < 0.8 } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_understaffed_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_rye_farm = { has_failed_hires = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_hiring_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { sed_state_labor_available < 5000 }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_labor_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_rye_farm = { building_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_input_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { sed_input_rye_farm_safe = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_forecast_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { OR = { b:building_rye_farm = { NOT = { OR = { has_active_production_method = pm_chemical_fertilizer has_active_production_method = pm_fertilization has_active_production_method = pm_simple_farming has_active_production_method = pm_soil_enriching_farming } } } sed_investment_rye_farm_output <= 0 } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_method_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { can_construct_building = building_rye_farm } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_permission_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { infrastructure_delta < 0 }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_infrastructure_states add = 1 } }
   }
  }  else_if = {
   limit = { has_building = building_rice_farm }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_grain_ignored }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_ignored_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { OR = { has_variable = sed_grain_request_pending b:building_rice_farm = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_pending_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { is_incorporated = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_unincorporated_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_rice_farm = { OR = { level <= 0 occupancy < 0.8 } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_understaffed_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_rice_farm = { has_failed_hires = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_hiring_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { sed_state_labor_available < 10000 }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_labor_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_rice_farm = { building_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_input_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { sed_input_rice_farm_safe = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_forecast_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { OR = { b:building_rice_farm = { NOT = { OR = { has_active_production_method = pm_chemical_fertilizer_building_rice_farm has_active_production_method = pm_fertilization_building_rice_farm has_active_production_method = pm_herring_meal_farming_building_rice_farm has_active_production_method = pm_simple_farming_building_rice_farm has_active_production_method = pm_soil_enriching_farming_building_rice_farm } } } sed_investment_rice_farm_output <= 0 } }

    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_ignored_states add = 1 } }
   }

   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { is_incorporated = yes } }

   }

   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_maize_farm = { has_failed_hires = yes } }

   }

 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled
   sed_grain_supply_demand = yes
  }
  ordered_scope_state = {
   limit = { sed_grain_candidate_eligible = yes }
   order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
   max = 3
   check_range_bounds = no
   root = { add_to_variable_list = { name = sed_grain_candidates target = prev } }
  }
 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_producer_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_ignored_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_pending_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_unincorporated_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_understaffed_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_hiring_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_input_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_method_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_permission_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_infrastructure_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_labor_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_forecast_states value = 0 }
 clear_variable_list = sed_fabric_candidates
 every_scope_state = {
  if = {
   limit = { has_variable = sed_fabric_request_pending
    NOT = { OR = { AND = { has_variable = sed_fabric_intent_variant OR = { AND = { var:sed_fabric_intent_variant = 1 has_building = building_cotton_plantation b:building_cotton_plantation = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } AND = { var:sed_fabric_intent_variant = 2 has_building = building_livestock_ranch b:building_livestock_ranch = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } } } AND = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_fabric_intent_variant } OR = { AND = { has_building = building_cotton_plantation b:building_cotton_plantation = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } AND = { has_building = building_livestock_ranch b:building_livestock_ranch = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } } } AND = { var:sed_fabric_intent_level = 0 NOT = { has_building = building_cotton_plantation has_building = building_livestock_ranch } owner = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > 0 } } } }
   }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_fabric_intent_variant has_variable = sed_fabric_intent_level }
    if = {
     limit = { var:sed_fabric_intent_variant = 1
      has_building = building_cotton_plantation
      b:building_cotton_plantation.level > var:sed_fabric_intent_level
     }
     sed_fabric_record_completed = yes
    }
    else_if = {
     limit = { var:sed_fabric_intent_variant = 2
      has_building = building_livestock_ranch
      b:building_livestock_ranch.level > var:sed_fabric_intent_level
     }
     sed_fabric_record_completed = yes
    }
    else = { sed_fabric_record_abandoned = yes }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_fabric_request_pending
  }
  if = {
   limit = { OR = { has_building = building_cotton_plantation has_building = building_livestock_ranch } }
   root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_producer_states add = 1 } }
  }
  if = { limit = { sed_fabric_candidate_eligible = yes } }
  else_if = {
   limit = { has_building = building_cotton_plantation }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_fabric_ignored }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_ignored_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { OR = { has_variable = sed_fabric_request_pending b:building_cotton_plantation = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_pending_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { is_incorporated = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_unincorporated_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_cotton_plantation = { OR = { level <= 0 occupancy < 0.8 } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_understaffed_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_cotton_plantation = { has_failed_hires = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_hiring_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { sed_state_labor_available < 8000 }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_labor_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_cotton_plantation = { building_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_input_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { sed_input_cotton_plantation_safe = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_forecast_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { OR = { b:building_cotton_plantation = { NOT = { OR = { has_active_production_method = automatic_irrigation_building_cotton_plantation has_active_production_method = default_building_cotton_plantation has_active_production_method = slave_exploitation_cotton has_active_production_method = worker_exploitation_cotton } } } sed_investment_cotton_plantation_output <= 0 } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_method_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { can_construct_building = building_cotton_plantation } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_permission_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { infrastructure_delta < 0 }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_infrastructure_states add = 1 } }
   }
  }  else_if = {
   limit = { has_building = building_livestock_ranch }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_fabric_ignored }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_ignored_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { OR = { has_variable = sed_fabric_request_pending b:building_livestock_ranch = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_pending_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { is_incorporated = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_unincorporated_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_livestock_ranch = { OR = { level <= 0 occupancy < 0.8 } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_understaffed_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_livestock_ranch = { has_failed_hires = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_hiring_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { sed_state_labor_available < 5000 }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_labor_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_livestock_ranch = { building_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_input_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { sed_input_livestock_ranch_safe = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_forecast_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { OR = { b:building_livestock_ranch = { NOT = { OR = { has_active_production_method = pm_intensive_grazing_ranch has_active_production_method = pm_sheep_farms has_active_production_method = pm_simple_ranch } } } sed_investment_livestock_ranch_output <= 0 } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_method_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { can_construct_building = building_livestock_ranch } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_permission_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { infrastructure_delta < 0 }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_infrastructure_states add = 1 } }
   }
  }
 }

 set_variable = { name = sed_tools_unincorporated_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_tools_understaffed_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_tools_hiring_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_tools_input_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_tools_method_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_tools_permission_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_tools_infrastructure_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_tools_labor_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_tools_forecast_states value = 0 }
 clear_variable_list = sed_tools_candidates
 every_scope_state = {
  if = {
   limit = { has_variable = sed_tools_request_pending
    NOT = { OR = { AND = { has_variable = sed_tools_intent_variant OR = { AND = { var:sed_tools_intent_variant = 1 has_building = building_tooling_workshop b:building_tooling_workshop = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } } } AND = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_tools_intent_variant } OR = { AND = { has_building = building_tooling_workshop b:building_tooling_workshop = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } } } AND = { var:sed_tools_intent_level = 0 NOT = { has_building = building_tooling_workshop } owner = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > 0 } } } }
   }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_tools_intent_variant has_variable = sed_tools_intent_level }
    if = {
     limit = { var:sed_tools_intent_variant = 1
      has_building = building_tooling_workshop
      b:building_tooling_workshop.level > var:sed_tools_intent_level
     }
     sed_tools_record_completed = yes
    }
    else = { sed_tools_record_abandoned = yes }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_tools_request_pending
  }
  if = {
   limit = { OR = { has_building = building_tooling_workshop } }
   root = { change_variable = { name = sed_tools_producer_states add = 1 } }
  }
  if = { limit = { sed_tools_candidate_eligible = yes } }
  else_if = {
   limit = { has_building = building_tooling_workshop }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_tools_ignored }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_tools_ignored_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { OR = { has_variable = sed_tools_request_pending b:building_tooling_workshop = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_tools_pending_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { is_incorporated = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_tools_unincorporated_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_tooling_workshop = { OR = { level <= 0 occupancy < 0.8 } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_tools_understaffed_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_tooling_workshop = { has_failed_hires = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_tools_hiring_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { sed_state_labor_available < 5000 }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_tools_labor_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_tooling_workshop = { building_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_tools_input_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { sed_input_tooling_workshop_safe = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_tools_forecast_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { OR = { b:building_tooling_workshop = { NOT = { OR = { has_active_production_method = pm_crude_tools has_active_production_method = pm_pig_iron has_active_production_method = pm_rubber_grips has_active_production_method = pm_steel } } } sed_investment_tooling_workshop_output <= 0 } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_tools_method_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { can_construct_building = building_tooling_workshop } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_tools_permission_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { infrastructure_delta < 0 }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_tools_infrastructure_states add = 1 } }
   }
  }
 }
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled
   sed_tools_supply_demand = yes
  }
  ordered_scope_state = {
   limit = { sed_tools_candidate_eligible = yes }
   order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
   max = 3
   check_range_bounds = no
   root = { add_to_variable_list = { name = sed_tools_candidates target = prev } }
  }
 }

   else_if = {
    limit = { OR = { b:building_artillery_foundry = { NOT = { OR = { has_active_production_method = pm_cannons has_active_production_method = pm_bronze_cannons has_active_production_method = pm_smoothbores has_active_production_method = pm_bronze_smoothbores has_active_production_method = pm_breech_loaders has_active_production_method = pm_recoiled_barrels } } } sed_investment_artillery_foundry_output <= 0 } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_artillery_method_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { can_construct_building = building_artillery_foundry } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_artillery_permission_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { infrastructure_delta < 0 }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_artillery_infrastructure_states add = 1 } }
   }
  }
 }
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled
   sed_artillery_supply_demand = yes
  }
  ordered_scope_state = {
   limit = { sed_artillery_candidate_eligible = yes }
   order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
   max = 3
   check_range_bounds = no
   root = { add_to_variable_list = { name = sed_artillery_candidates target = prev } }
  }
 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_ammunition_producer_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_ammunition_ignored_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_ammunition_pending_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_ammunition_unincorporated_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_ammunition_understaffed_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_ammunition_hiring_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_ammunition_input_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_ammunition_method_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_ammunition_permission_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_ammunition_infrastructure_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_ammunition_labor_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_ammunition_forecast_states value = 0 }
 clear_variable_list = sed_ammunition_candidates
 every_scope_state = {
  if = {
   limit = { has_variable = sed_ammunition_request_pending
    NOT = { OR = { AND = { has_variable = sed_ammunition_intent_variant OR = { AND = { var:sed_ammunition_intent_variant = 1 has_building = building_munition_plant b:building_munition_plant = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } } } AND = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_ammunition_intent_variant } OR = { AND = { has_building = building_munition_plant b:building_munition_plant = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } } } AND = { var:sed_ammunition_intent_level = 0 NOT = { has_building = building_munition_plant } owner = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > 0 } } } }
   }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_ammunition_intent_variant has_variable = sed_ammunition_intent_level }
    if = {
     limit = { var:sed_ammunition_intent_variant = 1
      has_building = building_munition_plant
      b:building_munition_plant.level > var:sed_ammunition_intent_level
     }
     sed_ammunition_record_completed = yes
    }
    else = { sed_ammunition_record_abandoned = yes }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_ammunition_request_pending
  }
  if = {
   limit = { OR = { has_building = building_munition_plant } }
   root = { change_variable = { name = sed_ammunition_producer_states add = 1 } }
  }
  if = { limit = { sed_ammunition_candidate_eligible = yes } }
  else_if = {
   limit = { has_building = building_munition_plant }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_ammunition_ignored }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_ammunition_ignored_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { OR = { has_variable = sed_ammunition_request_pending b:building_munition_plant = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_ammunition_pending_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { is_incorporated = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_ammunition_unincorporated_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_munition_plant = { OR = { level <= 0 occupancy < 0.8 } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_ammunition_understaffed_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_munition_plant = { has_failed_hires = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_ammunition_hiring_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { sed_state_labor_available < 5000 }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_ammunition_labor_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_munition_plant = { building_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_ammunition_input_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { sed_input_munition_plant_safe = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_ammunition_forecast_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { OR = { b:building_munition_plant = { NOT = { OR = { has_active_production_method = pm_percussion_caps has_active_production_method = pm_explosive_shells } } } sed_investment_munition_plant_output <= 0 } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_ammunition_method_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { can_construct_building = building_munition_plant } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_ammunition_permission_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { infrastructure_delta < 0 }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_ammunition_infrastructure_states add = 1 } }
   }
  }
 }
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled
   sed_ammunition_supply_demand = yes
  }
  ordered_scope_state = {
   limit = { sed_ammunition_candidate_eligible = yes }
   order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
   max = 3
   check_range_bounds = no
   root = { add_to_variable_list = { name = sed_ammunition_candidates target = prev } }
  }
 }

sed_run_wood_approval = {
 owner = { if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled } sed_refresh_investment_prices = yes sed_refresh_input_readings = yes if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } sed_refresh_direct_budget = yes } } }
 if = {
  limit = { sed_wood_approval_valid = yes }
  owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_queue_levels_before value = construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels } }
  owner = { sed_record_auto_attempt = yes }
  if = {
   limit = { sed_wood_logging_camp_investment_eligible = yes }
   # A founding reads level 0; the monthly review then infers completion from the queue.
   set_variable = { name = sed_wood_intent_level value = 0 }
   if = { limit = { has_building = building_logging_camp }
    set_variable = { name = sed_wood_intent_level value = b:building_logging_camp.level }
   }
   set_variable = { name = sed_wood_intent_variant value = 1 }
   start_building_construction = building_logging_camp
  }
  owner = {
   if = {
    limit = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > var:sed_queue_levels_before }
    set_variable = { name = sed_wood_action_status value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_wood_intents }
     change_variable = { name = sed_wood_intents add = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = sed_wood_intents value = 1 } }
    prev = {
     set_variable = { name = sed_wood_request_pending value = yes }
     if = { limit = { owner = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } var:sed_wood_intent_level = 0 }
      set_variable = { name = sed_wood_found_pm_pending value = var:sed_wood_intent_variant }
     }
    }
   }
   else = {
    set_variable = { name = sed_wood_action_status value = 2 }
    prev = {
     remove_variable = sed_wood_intent_level
     remove_variable = sed_wood_intent_variant
    }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_queue_levels_before
  }
 }
}
sed_wood_record_completed = {
 owner = {
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_wood_completed }
   change_variable = { name = sed_wood_completed add = 1 }
  }
  else = { set_variable = { name = sed_wood_completed value = 1 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_wood_result value = 1 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_wood_result_month value = sed_live_month_key }
 }
 remove_variable = sed_wood_intent_level
 remove_variable = sed_wood_intent_variant
}

  set_variable = { name = sed_wood_result_month value = sed_live_month_key }
 }
 remove_variable = sed_wood_intent_level

}

     }
    }
   }
   else = {
    set_variable = { name = sed_grain_action_status value = 2 }
    prev = {
     remove_variable = sed_grain_intent_level
     remove_variable = sed_grain_intent_variant
    }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_queue_levels_before
  }
 }
}

sed_run_fabric_approval = {
 owner = { if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled } sed_refresh_investment_prices = yes sed_refresh_input_readings = yes if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } sed_refresh_direct_budget = yes } } }
 if = {
  limit = { sed_fabric_approval_valid = yes }
  owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_queue_levels_before value = construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels } }
  owner = { sed_record_auto_attempt = yes }
  if = {
   limit = { sed_fabric_cotton_plantation_investment_eligible = yes OR = { owner = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } } sed_fabric_cotton_plantation_preferred_supplier = yes } }
   # A founding reads level 0; the monthly review then infers completion from the queue.
   set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_intent_level value = 0 }
   if = { limit = { has_building = building_cotton_plantation }
    set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_intent_level value = b:building_cotton_plantation.level }
   }
   set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_intent_variant value = 1 }
   start_building_construction = building_cotton_plantation
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { sed_fabric_livestock_ranch_investment_eligible = yes OR = { owner = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } } sed_fabric_livestock_ranch_preferred_supplier = yes } }
   # A founding reads level 0; the monthly review then infers completion from the queue.
   set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_intent_level value = 0 }
   if = { limit = { has_building = building_livestock_ranch }
    set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_intent_level value = b:building_livestock_ranch.level }
   }
   set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_intent_variant value = 2 }
   start_building_construction = building_livestock_ranch
  }
  owner = {
   if = {
    limit = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > var:sed_queue_levels_before }
    set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_action_status value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_fabric_intents }
     change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_intents add = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_intents value = 1 } }
    prev = {
     set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_request_pending value = yes }
     if = { limit = { owner = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } var:sed_fabric_intent_level = 0 }
      set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_found_pm_pending value = var:sed_fabric_intent_variant }
     }
    }
   }
   else = {
    set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_action_status value = 2 }
    prev = {
     remove_variable = sed_fabric_intent_level
     remove_variable = sed_fabric_intent_variant
    }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_queue_levels_before
  }
 }
}

sed_run_paper_approval = {
 owner = { if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled } sed_refresh_investment_prices = yes sed_refresh_input_readings = yes if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } sed_refresh_direct_budget = yes } } }
 if = {
  limit = { sed_paper_approval_valid = yes }
  owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_queue_levels_before value = construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels } }
  owner = { sed_record_auto_attempt = yes }
  if = {
   limit = { sed_paper_paper_mill_investment_eligible = yes }
   # A founding reads level 0; the monthly review then infers completion from the queue.
   set_variable = { name = sed_paper_intent_level value = 0 }
   if = { limit = { has_building = building_paper_mill }
    set_variable = { name = sed_paper_intent_level value = b:building_paper_mill.level }
   }
   set_variable = { name = sed_paper_intent_variant value = 1 }
   start_building_construction = building_paper_mill
  }
  owner = {
   if = {
    limit = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > var:sed_queue_levels_before }
    set_variable = { name = sed_paper_action_status value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_paper_intents }
     change_variable = { name = sed_paper_intents add = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = sed_paper_intents value = 1 } }
    prev = {
     set_variable = { name = sed_paper_request_pending value = yes }
     if = { limit = { owner = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } var:sed_paper_intent_level = 0 }
      set_variable = { name = sed_paper_found_pm_pending value = var:sed_paper_intent_variant }
     }
    }
   }
   else = {
    set_variable = { name = sed_paper_action_status value = 2 }
    prev = {
     remove_variable = sed_paper_intent_level
     remove_variable = sed_paper_intent_variant
    }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_queue_levels_before
  }
 }
}
sed_paper_record_completed = {
 owner = {
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_paper_completed }
   change_variable = { name = sed_paper_completed add = 1 }
  }
  else = { set_variable = { name = sed_paper_completed value = 1 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_paper_result value = 1 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_paper_result_month value = sed_live_month_key }
 }
 remove_variable = sed_paper_intent_level
 remove_variable = sed_paper_intent_variant
}
sed_paper_record_abandoned = {
 owner = {
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_paper_abandoned }
   change_variable = { name = sed_paper_abandoned add = 1 }
  }
  else = { set_variable = { name = sed_paper_abandoned value = 1 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_paper_result value = 2 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_paper_result_month value = sed_live_month_key }
 }
 remove_variable = sed_paper_intent_level
 remove_variable = sed_paper_intent_variant
}
sed_set_mode_manual = {
 sed_coord_restore = yes
 sed_restore_fiscal_policy = yes
 sed_restore_wage_policy = yes
 sed_restore_military_wage_policy = yes
 sed_clear_pm_input_reservations = yes
 every_scope_state = {
  remove_variable = sed_wood_found_pm_pending
  remove_variable = sed_iron_found_pm_pending
  remove_variable = sed_coal_found_pm_pending
  remove_variable = sed_grain_found_pm_pending
  remove_variable = sed_fabric_found_pm_pending
  remove_variable = sed_tools_found_pm_pending
  remove_variable = sed_groceries_found_pm_pending
  remove_variable = sed_clothes_found_pm_pending
  remove_variable = sed_small_arms_found_pm_pending
  remove_variable = sed_artillery_found_pm_pending
  remove_variable = sed_ammunition_found_pm_pending
  remove_variable = sed_paper_found_pm_pending
 }
 remove_variable = sed_mode_manual remove_variable = sed_mode_assisted
 remove_variable = sed_mode_automatic
 set_variable = { name = sed_mode_manual value = yes }
 set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 0 }
 if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } sed_schedule_auto_event = yes }
}
sed_set_mode_assisted = {
 sed_coord_restore = yes
 sed_restore_fiscal_policy = yes
 sed_restore_wage_policy = yes
 sed_restore_military_wage_policy = yes
 sed_clear_pm_input_reservations = yes
 every_scope_state = {
  remove_variable = sed_wood_found_pm_pending
  remove_variable = sed_iron_found_pm_pending
  remove_variable = sed_coal_found_pm_pending
  remove_variable = sed_grain_found_pm_pending
  remove_variable = sed_fabric_found_pm_pending
  remove_variable = sed_tools_found_pm_pending
  remove_variable = sed_groceries_found_pm_pending
  remove_variable = sed_clothes_found_pm_pending
  remove_variable = sed_small_arms_found_pm_pending
  remove_variable = sed_artillery_found_pm_pending
  remove_variable = sed_ammunition_found_pm_pending
  remove_variable = sed_paper_found_pm_pending

 remove_variable = sed_mode_assisted remove_variable = sed_mode_manual

 set_variable = { name = sed_mode_assisted value = yes }

}
sed_set_mode_automatic = {
 remove_variable = sed_mode_automatic remove_variable = sed_mode_manual
 remove_variable = sed_mode_assisted
 set_variable = { name = sed_mode_automatic value = yes }
 set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 0 }
 if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_enabled NOT = { has_variable = sed_coord_active } sed_coord_tools_available = yes } sed_coord_enable = yes }
 if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } sed_schedule_auto_event = yes }
}
sed_schedule_auto_event = {
 if = {
  limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic NOT = { has_variable = sed_auto_event_pending } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_auto_event_pending value = yes }
  trigger_event = { id = sed_pulse.1 days = 23 }
 }
}
sed_schedule_auto_retry = {
 if = {
  limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic NOT = { has_variable = sed_auto_event_pending }
   NOT = { AND = { has_variable = sed_auto_retry_month var:sed_auto_retry_month = sed_live_month_key } }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_auto_event_pending value = yes }
  set_variable = { name = sed_auto_retry_month value = sed_live_month_key }
  trigger_event = { id = sed_pulse.1 days = 7 }
 }
}
sed_auto_apply_monthly = {
 sed_configure_founded_industries = yes
 sed_refresh_national_plan = yes
 sed_recover_existing_industry = yes
 sed_modernize_existing_industry = yes
 if = { limit = { sed_pm_upgrade_month_limit_reached = yes has_variable = sed_pm_upgrade_status OR = { var:sed_pm_upgrade_status = 1 var:sed_pm_upgrade_status = 3 } }
  sed_refresh_national_plan = yes
 }
 sed_apply_fiscal_policy = yes
 sed_apply_wage_policy = yes
 sed_apply_military_wage_policy = yes
 set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 2 }
 if = {
  limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_active }
  sed_coord_sync = yes
  if = { limit = { var:sed_coord_executor = 11 } sed_auto_run_direct = yes }
  else = {
   set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 18 }
   if = { limit = { var:sed_coord_executor = 12 } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 21 } }
   else_if = { limit = { var:sed_coord_executor = 10 } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 20 } }
   else_if = { limit = { var:sed_coord_executor = 9 } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 19 } }
   else_if = { limit = { var:sed_coord_executor = 5 } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 13 } }
   else_if = { limit = { var:sed_coord_executor = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 2 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { sed_coord_fiscal_safe = yes } } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 17 } }
   }
  }
 }
 else = { sed_auto_run_direct = yes }
 if = { limit = { sed_pm_upgrade_month_limit_reached = yes has_variable = sed_pm_upgrade_status }
  set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 24 }
  if = { limit = { var:sed_pm_upgrade_status = 1 } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 23 } }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_pm_upgrade_status = 3 } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 25 } }
 }
 # Store the actual result after either direct execution or delegation.
 set_variable = { name = sed_auto_review_status value = var:sed_auto_action_status }
 set_variable = { name = sed_auto_review_year value = year }
 set_variable = { name = sed_auto_review_month value = { value = month add = 1 } }
 # One late second look per month when a transient queue pause clears.
 if = { limit = { OR = { var:sed_auto_review_status = 11 var:sed_auto_review_status = 12 } }
  sed_schedule_auto_retry = yes
 }
}

sed_auto_run_direct = {
 sed_refresh_input_readings = yes
 sed_refresh_direct_budget = yes
 if = {
  limit = { sed_auto_executor_safe = yes }

  if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_railway_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_railway_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_railway_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_railway_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = infrastructure_delta multiply = -1 }
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no
    # A candidate was selected; only confirmed insertion changes this to success.
    owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 } }
    sed_run_railway_approval = yes
   }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_wood_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_wood_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_wood_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_wood_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no
    # A candidate was selected; only confirmed insertion changes this to success.
    owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 } }
    sed_run_wood_approval = yes
   }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_iron_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_iron_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_iron_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_iron_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no
    # A candidate was selected; only confirmed insertion changes this to success.
    owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 } }
    sed_run_iron_approval = yes
   }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_coal_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_coal_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_coal_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_coal_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no
    # A candidate was selected; only confirmed insertion changes this to success.
    owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 } }
    sed_run_coal_approval = yes
   }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_grain_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_grain_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_grain_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_grain_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no
    # A candidate was selected; only confirmed insertion changes this to success.
    owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 } }
    sed_run_grain_approval = yes
   }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_fabric_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_fabric_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_fabric_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_fabric_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no
    # A candidate was selected; only confirmed insertion changes this to success.
    owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 } }
    sed_run_fabric_approval = yes
   }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_tools_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_tools_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_tools_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_tools_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no
    # A candidate was selected; only confirmed insertion changes this to success.
    owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 } }
    sed_run_tools_approval = yes
   }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_groceries_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_groceries_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_groceries_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_groceries_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no
    # A candidate was selected; only confirmed insertion changes this to success.
    owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 } }
    sed_run_groceries_approval = yes
   }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_clothes_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_clothes_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_clothes_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_clothes_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
    max = 1

   }

  else_if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_small_arms_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_small_arms_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_small_arms_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_small_arms_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no

    owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 } }
    sed_run_small_arms_approval = yes
   }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_artillery_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_artillery_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_artillery_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_artillery_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
    max = 1

    max = 1

  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_paper_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_paper_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_paper_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_paper_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no
    # A candidate was selected; only confirmed insertion changes this to success.
    owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 } }
    sed_run_paper_approval = yes
   }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_construction_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_construction_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_construction_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_construction_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no
    # A candidate was selected; only confirmed insertion changes this to success.
    owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 } }
    sed_run_construction_approval = yes
   }
  }
 }
 else_if = { limit = { in_default = yes } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 10 } }
 else_if = { limit = { sed_auto_month_limit_reached = yes } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 16 } }
 else_if = { limit = { construction_queue_num_queued_private_levels > 0 } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 11 } }
 else_if = { limit = { is_construction_paused = yes } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 12 } }
 else_if = { limit = { sed_competing_builder_configured = yes } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 13 } }
 else_if = { limit = { NOT = { sed_direct_fiscal_safe = yes } } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 17 } }
 else_if = { limit = { NOT = { sed_direct_budget_safe = yes } } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 22 } }
 else = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 14 } }
}
sed_ignore_railway = {
 if = {
  limit = { owner = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled } sed_railway_candidate_eligible = yes }
  set_variable = { name = sed_railway_ignored value = yes }
  owner = { sed_refresh_diagnostics = yes }
 }
}

sed_restore_ignored = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled }
  every_scope_state = {
  remove_variable = sed_railway_ignored
  remove_variable = sed_construction_ignored
  remove_variable = sed_wood_ignored
  remove_variable = sed_iron_ignored
  remove_variable = sed_coal_ignored
  remove_variable = sed_grain_ignored
  remove_variable = sed_fabric_ignored
  remove_variable = sed_tools_ignored
  remove_variable = sed_groceries_ignored
  remove_variable = sed_clothes_ignored
  remove_variable = sed_small_arms_ignored
  remove_variable = sed_artillery_ignored
  remove_variable = sed_ammunition_ignored
  remove_variable = sed_paper_ignored
  }
  sed_refresh_diagnostics = yes
 }
}
sed_refresh_national_plan = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled }
  sed_refresh_investment_prices = yes
  sed_refresh_input_readings = yes
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_count value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_count value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_goal value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_waiting value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_year value = year }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_month value = { value = month add = 1 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_reserve_floor value = { value = fixed_expenses min = 0 multiply = 12 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_reserve_required value = {
   value = var:sed_reserve_floor add = { value = net_total_income max = 0 multiply = -26 }
  } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_reserve_spare value = { value = gold_reserves subtract = var:sed_reserve_floor min = 0 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_reserve_runway value = 0 }
  if = { limit = { net_total_income < 0 }
   set_variable = { name = sed_reserve_runway value = { value = var:sed_reserve_spare divide = { value = net_total_income multiply = -1 } } }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_fiscal_status value = 1 }
  if = { limit = { in_default = yes } set_variable = { name = sed_fiscal_status value = 4 } }
  else_if = {
   limit = { OR = {
    AND = { net_total_income < 0 gold_reserves < { value = net_total_income multiply = -4 } }
    AND = { principal > 0 OR = { credit <= 0 principal > { value = credit multiply = 0.9 } } }
   } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_fiscal_status value = 3 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { sed_coord_reserve_drawdown_safe = yes } set_variable = { name = sed_fiscal_status value = 5 } }
  else_if = { limit = { NOT = { sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes } } set_variable = { name = sed_fiscal_status value = 2 } }
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_railway
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_construction

  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_wood value = 0 }
  if = { limit = {

   market = { mg:wood ?= { market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
   NOT = { any_scope_state = { OR = { has_building = building_logging_camp } } }
  }
   set_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_wood value = 1 }
   change_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_count add = 1 }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_pressure_wood value = {
   value = 0
   market ?= { mg:wood ?= {
    if = { limit = { market_goods_buy_orders > 0 }
     add = { value = market_goods_buy_orders subtract = market_goods_sell_orders
      divide = market_goods_buy_orders min = 0 max = 1 multiply = 100 }
    }
   } }
  } }
  if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_wood_short_sample_month } }
   remove_variable = sed_wood_short_months
   remove_variable = sed_wood_meta_year
  }
  if = { limit = {  market = { mg:wood ?= { market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } } }
   if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_wood_short_sample_month var:sed_wood_short_sample_month = sed_live_month_key } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_short_sample_gap value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_wood_short_sample_month }
     set_variable = { name = sed_short_sample_gap value = { value = sed_live_month_key subtract = var:sed_wood_short_sample_month } }
    }
    if = { limit = { var:sed_short_sample_gap = 1 has_variable = sed_wood_short_months }
     change_variable = { name = sed_wood_short_months add = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = sed_wood_short_months value = 1 } }
    remove_variable = sed_short_sample_gap
   }
   else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_wood_short_months } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_wood_short_months value = 1 }
   }
   if = { limit = { var:sed_wood_short_months >= 3 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_wood_meta_year value = year }
   }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = sed_wood_short_months }
  set_variable = { name = sed_wood_short_sample_month value = sed_live_month_key }
